name: Time of the Lillies
source: Precinct Inspector Carola escapes the repressive communist country of Staven after having worked in the secret police (State Security) for a decade. However, upon arriving in the Five Republics, she soon finds herself tangled in a conspiracy involving federal police, leftist terror cells, and an imperialist proxy war in the nation of Cosagoria...
